highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Studying Electrical Engineering - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Is Electrical Engineering available in English in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Leading Finnish universities including Aalto University, Tampere University, and the University of Oulu offer 100% English-taught master

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Electrical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees for non-EU/EEA students range between €10,000 and €17,000 per year (approximately ₹10.5 to ₹17.85 lakh per annum). Merit-based scholarships covering 50% to 100% of tuition are widely available.

faq.question: Is IELTS required to study Electrical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, proof of English proficiency is generally mandatory. Accepted tests include IELTS Academic (overall 6.5 minimum), TOEFL iBT (92+), and PTE Academic (62+).

faq.question: Can international graduates work in Finland after completing their degree?
faq.answer: Yes. Finland provides an extended 2-year post-study residence permit for international graduates, allowing them to work in engineering, automation, power systems, and technology consulting across the EU.
